old_problem: The source sets threshold 16 but gives no initial retired-page count or pages created per injection and lists one GFX injection while expecting threshold-retirement UMC, ODECC UMC and GFX-poison GC semantics. Clearing eight RAS EEPROM targets destroys the state needed to understand the boundary. Neither source nor approved generic rules define a finite causal sequence or CPER cardinality.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict under ED-16/ED-17/ED-19/ED-28/ED-30. The missing information is core vendor injection semantics and recovery, not a target IP or ordinary threshold parameter. A bounded signed AMD/FAE manifest must define starting count, threshold arithmetic, pages per injection, exact target/order/maximum injections, CPER multiplicity and restore behavior. EEPROM/log clearing remains prohibited until evidence is preserved and explicitly authorized.

Clearing RAS EEPROM across indices 0..7 and reloading amdgpu are destructive state mutations that need exact device inventory, preserved pre-state and reversible restoration authority.
